boundary: Twisted traces and voltage labels are finite nonbacktracking holonomies. No physical propagation, Hamiltonian, or optical phase law is inferred.

hashimoto.carrier_channel: The natural V9 is the multiplicity-nine adjacency eigenspace at each of +2 and -2. Under Ihara-Bass these feed the four factors (x^2-2x+2)^9 and (x^2+2x+2)^9, a 36-dimensional Hashimoto channel. The literal 24- and 90-sector maps both originate from this V9.

theorem: The Tutte-Coxeter C4 voltage action lifts exactly into the W33 separator. The 180 pair-transfer coordinates are the bipartite nonincidence complement, the 240 coordinates split into 62 C4 orbits, and the two carrier V9 copies couple precisely to the ±2 adjacency / four cyclotomic Hashimoto channels.

tutte_coxeter.fixed_octagon_action: The generator advances two steps around each octagon, acting as two 4-cycles on alternating bipartition vertices.

w33_240_coordinate_lift.pair_transfer_theorem: Each pair-transfer coordinate is uniquely a nonincident syntheme-duad pair. Thus the 180-sector is exactly the bipartite complement of the 45-edge Tutte-Coxeter Levi graph.
